description: This file defines a Fragment subclass named LogFragment which displays log messages within a ScrollView and LogView. It manages setting up the UI components, configuring their properties, and ensuring the log view scrolls to the bottom when text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays logs within a scrollable, monospace TextView for debugging purposes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView UI components, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy for the fragment, sets up a text change listener to auto-scroll the log view when new text is added.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance for external use.
